## [6.2.1-dev.1](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/compare/v6.2.0...v6.2.1) (2026-06-02)


### Bug Fixes

* **FotMob - `Hide ads`:** Update method matcher to support new versions ([510f474](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/commit/510f4742))
* **Twitter - Hide ads:** Hook the correct method by using the correct descriptor ([3151b3b](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/commit/3151b3bc))
* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** Fix keyword filter by making filtering via the buffer work again ([ea983b1](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/commit/ea983b1f))
* **YouTube - Spoof video streams:** Fix playback using the unauthenticated Reel player client ([6a7ba9f](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/commit/6a7ba9fc))


### Features

* **Instagram:** Update patches to work with `425.0.0.47.61` ([cb49ee1](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/commit/cb49ee1d))
* **Strava:** Add `Export route` patch ([1362836](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/commit/1362836c))
* **TikTok - Feed filter:** Add filter to hide AI-generated content ([26562d5](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/commit/26562d59))
* **X / Twitter:** Support `v11.80.0-release.0` ([3bb2b1d](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/commit/3bb2b1d1))
* **YouTube:** Add `Dim Shorts player buttons` patch ([3f48d91](https://gitlab.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/commit/3f48d916))
